decisions.reason: As an older 2018 CD close to the core range, it has had enough time to prove itself, and if it has not become a steady catalog seller the firm would likely reallocate shelf, warehouse, and attention to better-performing core titles or new releases.

Because this illustrated release series builds on the firm's curatorial strengths and differentiation, management is likely to tolerate some uncertainty and keep it if performance is at least near aspiration and strategically useful.

A jazz vinyl reissue fits the stated goal of broadening genre coverage while staying close to existing capabilities, so with industry growth and manageable risk the firm would likely continue it unless sales clearly disappoint.
A multi-disc box set is resource-intensive and niche, so if results are merely middling relative to aspiration the firm would be inclined to discontinue it and free capital tied up in stock.

Since this 2019 compilation CD received weaker website prominence and is less distinctive than the firm's more curated products, management would likely judge it below aspiration and exit within the year.
